catch_age_evidence: Native 2023 input has annual North and South catch totals and expanded commercial age frequencies. Catch-at-age can be reconstructed from fleet catch and age proportions; it is not supplied as the original likelihood observation.
survey_age_evidence: Triennial and WCGBTS have aggregate biomass indices. WCGBTS length and age samples support an approximate index age split; the Triennial survey has no age samples and cannot receive an age-specific index.
weights_evidence: Sex-specific weight-length relationships are estimated externally; growth is estimated in the model. Age-specific weights require documented conversion through growth.
maturity_evidence: The 2023 run uses a newly estimated female maturity-at-length ogive; an age-specific surface requires documented conversion through growth.
mortality_evidence: Sex-specific M is estimated with lognormal meta-analytical priors, median 5.4/Amax and log-scale SD 0.31; maximum ages are 32 years for females and 29 for males. Report.sso includes fitted M.
timing_evidence: Survey indices are recorded in July (month 7); native fleet settings encode survey timing 1007. Preserve the model convention and document conversion to fractional-year timing.
output_evidence: Fitted Report.sso includes annual N-at-age, F-at-age, catch-at-age and natural mortality. Its 2023 spawning output of 7.68553 trillion eggs matches the assessment report rounded to 7.686.
decision_reason: Eligible for source curation and translation with documented reconstruction of catch-at-age and WCGBTS index age splits, and age-scale derivation of weights and maturity. The Triennial survey has no age observations; this is not direct equivalence to the official likelihood.
notes: 2023 full benchmark is the latest completed detailed assessment located. catch_age_evidence: 2024 Model 24.1b uses total dead catch; fishery age compositions are available only in 2000, 2002 and 2003, not as a complete catch-at-age series.
survey_age_evidence: EBS survey biomass is available; bottom-trawl age compositions cover intermittent years and acoustic-trawl age compositions cover 1994-2024. These are conditional compositions, not an unconditional abundance-at-age series.
weights_evidence: Native Model 24.1b files contain annual fishery/stock weight-at-age calculations; the report cross-check and distinction from input compositions are documented in source_reviews/afsc_alaska_plaice_bsai.md.
maturity_evidence: The applied run uses a fixed female maturity-at-age vector across ages 0-25+; source vector is retained with the native assessment inputs.
mortality_evidence: Natural mortality is fixed at 0.13 per year for both sexes; the report and native controls agree.
timing_evidence: EBS survey observations use month 7 (fraction 0.5); timing is specified in the production input files.
output_evidence: Official Model 24.1b Report.sso and SAFE report provide annual N-at-age, F-at-age, SSB, recruitment and biomass outputs, 1975-2024.
decision_reason: Matched the existing BSAI Alaska plaice record. The official 2024 model and outputs are verified, but full catch-at-age is not supplied and fishery age compositions occur in only three years; composition-only evidence does not meet the required catch-age or reconstructable-source threshold.
notes: Model: final SSC-selected 2024 Model 24.1b, Stock Synthesis 3.30.22; native repository revision 96b65a032cda06013376a8c8a11b553ebf194784. Source cache and remaining composition/weight/uncertainty details are documented in source_reviews/afsc_alaska_plaice_bsai.md. catch_age_evidence: Native input has fleet annual catch totals, catch-expanded length compositions and conditional age-at-length samples. Catch-at-age is not direct; these source quantities support a documented reconstruction.
survey_age_evidence: The WCGBTS and Triennial trawl surveys have aggregate biomass indices, length compositions and conditional age-at-length samples. An age-specific index requires a documented age split; CalCOFI and RREAS are distinct special indices.
weights_evidence: Empirical weight-at-age input is disabled. Growth is estimated and weight-at-length is specified; official fitted outputs include derived weight-at-age.
maturity_evidence: The 2025 model reuses the 2015 female maturity-at-length relationship; an age-scale curve requires conversion using estimated growth.
mortality_evidence: Female M uses a lognormal prior with median 5.4/Amax and log-scale SD 0.31; male M is an estimated exponential offset without an explicit prior. Report.sso includes age- and sex-specific M.
timing_evidence: Survey and composition records use July (month 7); retain the source month and document conversion to a fractional-year convention.
output_evidence: The native Report.sso includes N-at-age, F-at-age, catch-at-age, natural mortality, spawning output and recruitment. Its 2025 spawning output matches the report value to rounding.
decision_reason: Eligible for source curation and translation with explicit documented reconstructions of catch-at-age and trawl index age splits, plus age-scale weight and maturity derivations. This does not imply direct equivalence to the official likelihood.

catch_age_evidence: SAR 2025/026 and pinned base input contain total biomass catch and fishery age proportions; verify whether expansion to catch numbers-at-age is supported without fitted states.
survey_age_evidence: SAR 2025/026: six survey abundance indices and age-frequency proportions from three surveys; inspect observed scales, sample years and age coverage.
weights_evidence: SAR 2025/026: sex-specific growth and weight-length relationships estimated externally; native control sets use_watage=0. Recover appropriate age-specific weights.
maturity_evidence: SAR 2025/026: female maturity estimated externally; control file reads an age-maturity matrix. Verify the matrix and age definition.
mortality_evidence: SAR 2025/026 states sex-specific estimated natural mortalities; production posterior values and uncertainty require verification.
timing_evidence: The base input has survey observation months; verify year-specific timing and stock-synthesis convention.
output_evidence: SAR 2025/026 Figure 1 plots age-0 recruitment and relative spawning biomass with 90% credibility intervals; historical numeric output and comparable absolute SSB need recovery.
decision_reason: Screened: official 2024 input/control files and assessment summary exist, but age/year reconstruction, biological surfaces, observation interpretation and historical numerical outputs remain unverified.
notes: Regional DFO listing supplementary to 2024 Sustainability Survey. 2024 catch is a repeated 2023 provisional value.
